description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the ConnectionFactoryImpl class in the org.eclipse.hono.connection.impl package. It verifies various behaviors such as connection success/failure, timeout handling, SASL mechanism configurations, and SSL/TLS settings.

classes.name: ConnectionFactoryImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying behaviors of the ConnectionFactoryImpl class, including connection attempts, timeout, SASL mechanisms, and TLS configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the fixture with default client configuration properties before each test.

methods.name: testConnectInvokesHandlerOnFailureToConnect
methods.description: Tests that the connect method invokes the failure handler when unable to connect to a non-existing server.

methods.name: testConnectInvokesHandlerOnConnectTimeout
methods.description: Tests that a timeout results in a ConnectTimeoutException being thrown and the handler being invoked.

methods.name: testConnectInvokesHandlerOnDisconnectAfterSendingOpenFrame
methods.description: Verifies that connection disconnection after sending AMQP open frame triggers the failure handler.

methods.name: testConnectDoesNotUseSaslPlainForEmptyUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Checks that SASL_PLAIN mechanism is not enabled when username and password are empty strings.

methods.name: testConnectAddsSaslPlainForNonEmptyUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Checks that SASL_PLAIN mechanism is enabled when username and password are non-empty.

methods.name: testConnectEnablesSslIfExplicitlyConfigured
methods.description: Verifies that explicit TLS enablement in configuration results in SSL being used during connection.

methods.name: testConnectEnablesSslIfTrustStoreIsConfigured
methods.description: Verifies that configuring a trust store path results in SSL being used even if TLS is not explicitly enabled.
